message: Hi, my kid Mo is 7 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 4-12. Mo would be a great fit. We offer a free trial class so he can check it out and see if he likes it. Would you like to get him signed up for a trial?
Yes, I’d love to sign Mo up for a trial class! What time do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.jasper@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Now I just need Mo's full name and date of birth to get him registered for the trial.
Mo's full name is Mo Jasper, and his birthday is February 22, 2019.

Awesome! I have Mo all set. Here are some available times for his trial class:

- Tuesday, July 7th at 5:00 PM
- Wednesday, July 8th at 5:00 PM
- Thursday, July 9th at 5:00 PM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday, July 7th at 5:00 PM.

Perfect! Mo is all booked for Tuesday, July 7th at 5:00 PM for his free trial class. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.jasper@gmail.com with all the details. Just have him wear comfortable workout clothes. See you then!
